residencyRequirements.description: Filed where the marriage was solemnized, or where the parties last resided together, or where the respondent resides, or where the petitioner (wife) resides (HMA s.19 / SMA s.31).

waitingPeriod.description: Mutual consent: 6-month cooling-off period (HMA s.13B(2)). Courts may waive per Amardeep Singh v. Harveen Kaur (2017). SC may also grant divorce under Art. 142 on irretrievable breakdown (Shilpa Sailesh v. Varun Sreenivasan (2023)). Contested: no fixed waiting period.

noFault.name: Mutual Consent
noFault.description: Both spouses jointly petition after 1+ year separation. 6-month cooling-off applies.
